name: io.github.whosman/chessclubladder
title: Club Ladder
description: Public chess club ladders, a Lichess and chess.com rating converter, and Lichess clubs by rating.

tools.name: start_club_ladder
tools.description: Use when someone wants a rating ladder for their own chess club, class or group. Give the club's Lichess team or chess.com club as a link, an id or a name. Returns the club as found, a Start page link with that club filled in, what the free plan and the Club pass include, and the Discord app link when the club uses Discord. The organizer creates the ladder in the browser from that link; this tool creates nothing.

club.description: A Lichess team link (lichess.org/team/...), a chess.com club link (chess.com/club/...), a team id or club slug, or the club's name.

site.description: Which site the club is on. Needed only when club is a bare id; narrows a name search.

uses_discord.description: True when the club has a Discord server, false when it has none. Leave out when not known.

tools.name: list_public_ladders
tools.description: Public ladders on Club Ladder: ladders whose organizers made them public, with name, id, player count and link. Use to find a club's ladder by name before reading its standings. Private ladders and ladders shared only by link are never listed.

name.description: Words from the ladder's name or description. Leave out to list them all.

tools.name: get_public_ladder
tools.description: Standings of one public ladder, by id or ladder link: each named player's Lichess and chess.com rating, change and games in one time control, sorted as on the ladder page, plus this week's awards and recent results. Comes in pages; use offset for the next page. Private and link-only ladders are never returned.

id.description: The ladder id, the part after /l/ in its link (for example demo-club), or the whole link.

period.description: Days to measure change over: 7 (default) or 30, or season for a ladder with seasons.

time_control.description: Time control to rank by. Default: the one most of the club plays.

offset.description: Players to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

results_limit.description: How many recent weekly awards and challenge results to include. Default 5.

tools.name: estimate_rating
tools.description: Converts one rating between Lichess and chess.com for a time control, from people who play on both sites. Give lichess or chesscom (exactly one) and time_control. Returns the estimate on the other site and the range most people with that rating fall in.

time_control.description: Time control. Each site and time control is its own rating pool.

lichess.description: A Lichess rating to convert to chess.com.

chesscom.description: A chess.com rating to convert to Lichess.

tools.name: rating_percentile
tools.description: Where one Lichess or chess.com rating sits among the club players, team members and people on both sites whose settled ratings Club Ladder reads: the share below it and the percentiles of that pool. Give lichess or chesscom (exactly one) and time_control. Use for questions like whether a rating is good.

time_control.description: Time control. Each site and time control is its own rating pool.

tools.name: find_lichess_clubs
tools.description: Up to ten Lichess clubs (teams) where the given rating sits in the middle half of the members' blitz or rapid ratings, largest first, with member counts, medians, how many members were active in the last month, and a Start link for each. Use when a player wants a club at their level.

rating.description: A Lichess blitz or rapid rating.

open_to_join.description: True for clubs anyone can join without approval. Default false.
